findings.claim: Retry loader failures through the router before clearing the error boundary.
findings.detail: The default Try again button only invokes the React boundary reset. TanStack retains the failed route match, so rendering throws the same loader error again without calling the loader. In the built browser fixture the loader failed once; clicking Try again left attempts=1 and Transient failure visible. router.invalidate() immediately ran attempt 2 and rendered Recovered. Use router.invalidate() (and coordinate reset as necessary) for route-loader errors.
findings.evidence: retry-before.json; retry-after-invalidate.json; browser/main.tsx; TanStack CatchBoundary/Match source
findings.layer: Built package, real TanStack Router and Chrome DOM

findings.claim: Normalize trailing slashes on route keys as well as incoming pathnames.
findings.detail: compileRoute preserves a required slash in /about/ and /blog/$slug/, but normalizePathname removes it from every incoming path. These keys can never resolve. The real TanStack Router matches both /about and /about/ to /about/, while this adapter returns null for both. collectStaticPaths still emits /about/, yielding a generated prerender path getPageData rejects. Normalize patterns without losing their original lookup identity, or validate and explicitly reject unsupported keys.
findings.layer: Built adapter versus pinned TanStack Router runtime

findings.claim: Normalize the head pathname consistently with the loader pathname.
findings.detail: For a static route /café, the documented loader passes decoded location.pathname=/café and renders its page, but the documented head hook passes encoded match.pathname=/caf%C3%A9. matchRoute compares literal static segments, misses the route, and getHead silently returns root metadata. The SSR fixture rendered Cafe body with SSR proof as its title instead of the route title Cafe page. Use the same pathname representation at both hooks, with safe segment encoding semantics.
findings.evidence: ssr-unicode.mjs; ssr-unicode.json; documented head hook in packages/tanstack-start/README.md:124
findings.layer: Real TanStack match records and rendered SSR HTML

findings.claim: Account for HeadContent deduplication before advertising multiple Open Graph images.
findings.detail: StartMetadata accepts images:string[] and metadataToHead emits repeated og:image descriptors. The pinned TanStack HeadContent deduplicates by property and retains the last descriptor, so images ["/a.png","/b.png"] becomes only /b.png in rendered HTML. This silently drops the first/preferred image and every additional image. Preserve supported multi-image semantics at the rendering boundary or explicitly narrow the API and choose the intended single image.
